verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI spec at https://docs.perplexity.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). The API reference pages show structured request and response schemas, and llms.txt plus markdown doc variants give extra machine-readable surfaces. Missing for 10: first-party docs that advertise or explain the OpenAPI download, and any evidence of the spec's completeness or version coverage across the Agent, Search, Sonar and Embeddings endpoints.
